events.title: UNFURLED - Art Exhibition by Fee Bissett & Marianne Wilson
events.description: An opening evening for a collaborative exhibition by local artists Fee Bissett and Marianne Wilson. Expect an intimate gallery atmosphere with opportunities to meet the artists and discuss their latest works.

events.title: SecTalks Gold Coast 3x7 - Exploring Malware Evolution Through ML
events.description: A technical talk exploring the intersection of machine learning and malware development. This is a community-run event at the Cohort innovation hub, ideal for tech-curious individuals interested in cybersecurity and systems thinking.

events.title: Saturday Afternoon Board Games
events.description: A casual, community-focused meetup where people gather to play a variety of board games. Perfect for those looking to meet open-minded, thoughtful people in a relaxed, low-pressure library setting.

events.title: Rainbow Bay SLSC 5km loop (GC Oceanway walk)
events.location: Rainbow Bay Surf Life Saving Club, Coolangatta
events.source: Gold Coast Active and Social Meetup Group
events.description: A social 5km walking group exploring the Gold Coast Oceanway. This is an active and outdoor community event that encourages conversation while engaging with the local coastal environment.
